Hanno Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the following period.

We apologize for any inconvenience. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (All Day)】

December 4, 2025 (Friday) through January 15, 2026 (Friday)

【What to Do During the Closure】

• You cannot use the library for browsing, borrowing books, or returning books at the Children's Library.

• If you have a hold on a book at the Children's Library, please pick it up at Hanno Municipal Library instead.

• The book drop box remains available during the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
summary: 📚 Hanno Children's Library temporarily closed (December 4, 2025 – January 15, 2026)
